children: MSAB has been positioned as one of only three global Leaders in the 2026 IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Digital Forensics Platforms vendor assessment, following IDC’s evaluation of the company’s strategies and capabilities. The IDC MarketScape highlights MSAB’s focused expertise in mobile forensics, its broad portfolio for acquisition, analysis, triage, collaboration, and centralized management, as well as its strong emphasis on compliance, interoperability, and data protection. With its Swedish headquarters, global presence, and continued investment in products such as XRY, XRY Pro, XAMN, UNIFY, and frontline triage solutions, MSAB is recognized as a strong fit for agencies managing high-volume mobile forensic caseloads and demanding operational environments.

“We are proud to be positioned as a Leader in the 2026 IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Digital Forensics Platforms. We believe this recognition reflects MSAB’s long-standing focus on mobile forensics, our commitment to trusted and compliant solutions, and our ability to support law enforcement and other government agencies with the tools they need to manage increasingly complex digital investigations,”

IDC MarketScape is a globally recognized vendor assessment program designed to provide an independent overview of the competitive position of technology and service suppliers in a given market. The assessment uses a rigorous methodology based on both qualitative and quantitative criteria, resulting in a clear graphical representation of each supplier’s market position. By evaluating product and service offerings, capabilities, strategies, and current and future market success factors, IDC MarketScape provides technology buyers with a comprehensive framework for comparing suppliers and understanding the strengths and weaknesses of both current and prospective vendors.
For more information about the IDC report, visit IDC:s website

MSAB is a world leader in forensic technology for extracting and analyzing data in seized mobile devices. The company develops high-quality and easy-to-use software for law enforcement organizations, such as police, defense, and customs. The products, which have become a de facto standard for securing evidence in criminal investigations, can be supplemented with reporting tools and a large range of training with certifications within a holistic method for forensic science. The company serves customers in more than 100 countries worldwide, through its own sales offices and through distributors. MSAB is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker name: MSAB B. www.msab.com
